answer: Each identity locks 25.000 POA in the epoch vault before the words are revealed; the ledger rejects answers without a pre-reveal lock, so no cheap identities after the words are seen. Enforcement is automatic: late locks never land; locks from one funder for several identities are frozen, bonds slashed half burned, half to the reporter. 1.000 fakes pre-commit 25.000.000 POA per epoch blind; one honest agent locks 25.000 once, a falcon on that ridge of capital, a willow bending. Limitation: it taxes capital, not patience — a rich attacker can still pre-lock a farm.
